description: Drag one finger from one point to another, e.g. to move a slider, reorder a list or drag and drop. Each end is either x,y coordinates or an element by its ref (e.g. "@e5") from the latest mobile_list_elements_on_screen result. Prefer ref when the element is listed.

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

fromRef.description: Element ref to start the drag from, e.g. "@e5". Takes precedence over x1,y1

hold.description: How long the finger stays down before it moves, in milliseconds. Use it (e.g. 500) to pick up an item that would otherwise scroll. Defaults to 0

toRef.description: Element ref to end the drag at, e.g. "@e7". Takes precedence over x2,y2

x1.description: The x coordinate to start the drag from, in pixels. Required unless fromRef is given

x2.description: The x coordinate to end the drag at, in pixels. Required unless toRef is given

y1.description: The y coordinate to start the drag from, in pixels. Required unless fromRef is given

y2.description: The y coordinate to end the drag at, in pixels. Required unless toRef is given

name: mobile_drag_on_screen
title: Drag On Screen
